The B2 Kimi loader builds CUDA-owned tensors explicitly and reuses preallocated Store chunks. Kimi native first-load maxima were 22.421 GiB (historical) and 21.880/21.759 GiB to native ready (210129Z/214730Z with the same two pools). GLM-5.3's eight-rank in-place load with Kimi asleep lost 20.830/18.984 GiB through registration and stage completion respectively. In the same S1 two-pool environment V4 in-place with two sleepers lost 23.412 GiB in 301 samples before its independent shape guard failed. Use 24 GiB as a conservative cross-model proxy, 8 GiB operating allowance, and the existing 55 GiB live stop for an 87 GiB provisional gate. Require measured S3 loading, Host KV, gold, Store bytes and release. No evidence for using this gate after the V4 Store eviction in S2.
